title: SkyTech Core
description: The core mod of the SkyTech Modpack
body:
# SkyTech Core
The core mod for the (upcoming) SkyTech modpack. Should only be used in the SkyTech modpack or other modpacks with this mod in mind.

## Features
- Wooden Shears
- Wooden Bucket
- Shift+Right-click on Grass Block to get Stone Pebbles

### Dependencies
- [Ex Deorum](https://modrinth.com/mod/ex-deorum)
- [Bucketlib](https://modrinth.com/mod/bucketlib)

Note: As of now, the SkyTech modpack hasn't released
